description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success.The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a proven track record in managing comprehensive healthcare services, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. You will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, driving operational excellence, and upholding the highest standards of quality care.Join a team committed to providing outstanding rehabilitation and long-term care services. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to contribute to a facility dedicated to community well-being.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Demonstrated leadership, operational, and financial management skills
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal long-term care regulations

description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Orthopedic (Hand) Surgeon to join a premier healthcare facility in the vibrant heart of NYC, NY. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated professional to contribute to a leading medical team, focusing on specialized hand surgery and patient care within a dynamic urban environment.

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and treating a wide range of hand and upper extremity conditions, including complex trauma, degenerative diseases, and congenital deformities. A significant portion of the practice involves managing Workers Comp and No-fault cases, requiring expertise in these specific areas. The compensation structure for this position is designed to reward high performance, with a strong emphasis on bonus potential.

If you are a board-certified Orthopedic (Hand) Surgeon with a passion for excellence and a proven track record in managing specialized cases, we encourage you to apply. Join a facility committed to delivering outstanding patient outcomes and fostering professional growth.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Active and unrestricted medical license in New York State
Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Orthopedic (Hand) Surgeon
Proven experience with Workers Comp and No-fault cases
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation includes a competitive base salary with significant bonus potential, heavily weighted towards performance-based bonuses.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) for a contract position within a supportive educational environment. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on students' communication development, working collaboratively with educators and families to foster a positive learning experience.

This is an initial contract role spanning from August 3, 2026, to May 24, 2027. We are looking for a passionate professional ready to contribute to a vibrant school community and support students in achieving their full potential.
requirements: Colorado Department of Education (CDE) Special Service Provider (SSP) license/endorsement
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $60 per hour, based on experience.
